ev.q: Getting Over It with Bennett Foddy is a punishing climbing game
you'll be able to jump, swing, climb and fly
Lose all your progress, over and over.
Instead, it punishes you at every fall, taunting you at every mistake
You move the hammer with the mouse, and that's all there is.
the controls were made to be wonky at best
Listen as I make philosophical observations about the problem at hand.
The median time to finish for my playtesters was 5 hours
However it cook close to 4 hours
